As the Communications Manager for Grab Thailand, you'll collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across verticals, commercial, marketing, and public affairs teams. Your primary focus will be crafting and executing PR and communication strategies to drive business objectives, particularly within our Deliveries and Financial businesses. We're seeking someone with a robust background in corporate and brand communications, a deep understanding of Thailand's media landscape, and adeptness in fostering and managing crucial media relationships. Experience in crisis management is a plus.

  • Develop and execute communication programs in line with Grab's vision and goals
  • Proactively identify and leverage publicity opportunities through various channels
  • Cultivate compelling media stories to bolster Grab Thailand's leadership position, with emphasis on Deliveries and Financial businesses
  • Forge and maintain strong ties with influential local media and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) in Thailand
  • Navigate and mitigate reputational risks and manage responses to incidents or crises
  • Oversee PR agency activities according to the agreed communication plan and budget

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in both Thai and English (written and spoken)
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills


The Nice To Haves

  • Background in the consumer technology sector
  • Experience in high-growth environments
  • Previous roles in journalism or strategic communications consultancy
  • Familiarity with social media and integrated marketing communications
  • Experience in multinational or global company

rows.title: Senior Economist (Data Scientist), Marketplace Strategy
rows.description:
The day to day activities


The day to day will see you working on varied tasks and projects, a selection of projects could include:

  • Working with product managers and product analysts to impact-size and prioritise product feature lists for our next development sprints
  • Running data-driven research to uncover new insights to inform product strategy, operational initiatives or changes in existing product configurations
  • Conducting independent analysis of marketplace issues identified in a specific market; delivering insights & recommendations to our ops teams to balance such issues
  • Sharing a recent piece of analysis or details of a new product with the rest of the team to provide coaching to help with similar projects
  • Presenting a strategic opportunity assessment & analysis to leadership
  • Writing a playbook to be used by operations teams which provides a mental model and documentation to tackle common marketplace situations supported by qualitative and/or quantitative insights
  • Working with local teams to plan and design experiments for demand, supply and market clearance levers (e.g. via changes in pricing, driver incentives, driver dispatch logic)


Qualifications

The must haves

  • At least 2 years of relevant work experience (for example in Analytics, Business Intelligence, Government, Management Consulting, or strategy roles in a tech company)
  • Strong analytical knowledge - Prior experience in handling large, complex, high velocity data; familiar with common statistical, analytical and ML techniques; willing to continue to learn/apply new techniques as required.
  • Strong understanding of causal inference - Able to design and recommend the most suitable ways for obtaining causal effects, be it through A/B tests or inference from quasi-experimental set-ups
  • Strong presentation skills - Ability to distill insights & articulate an actionable point of view to non-technical audiences; Comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders; Good command of storytelling and presentation techniques (e.g. slide making, data visualisation)
  • Convincing meeting presence and strong stakeholder management / influencing skills - Ability to get buy-in and drive decisions within the space of a meeting
  • Problem solving & can do attitude - willing to learn quickly and understand the root cause of problems; able to work with a multidisciplinary team to propose creative solutions
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities and solve ambiguous problems that may evolve in scope or complexity
  • Good understanding of SQL and R/Python to work with data, including common packages/libraries
  • Willing to travel (subject to travel guidance by Grab)


Good to have

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Psychology, Anthropology, Sociology, Computer Science, Data Science or related fields.
  • Interest and experience in real-world applications of data science and data analytics - such as NLP, ML, Network analysis, spatial, econometrics or time-series analysis.
  • Prior experience in training data science models using common machine learning libraries.
  • Prior experience in Product Management.
  • Prior experience in an operations role in a ‘direct-to-consumer’, online business or startup

rows.description:
Your Responsibilities Will Include

  • Enhancing underwriting and portfolio management risk policies through the application of analytics and strategies for consumers and eco-system partner portfolios.
  • Regularly scrutinizing portfolio risk reports, utilizing them to identify and seize opportunities for improving credit efficiency.
  • Providing ad-hoc credit risk assessments to key stakeholders.

  • Assisting in product and credit program development, reviewing and estimating risk parameters, product pricing, structure, and ensuring regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborating with potential partners to drive business agenda, ensuring optimal risk and profitability economics.
  • Managing expectations and discussions with external stakeholders effectively.
  • Mentoring and guiding junior risk members in the team.


Qualifications

The Must Haves:

  • A Master’s/Bachelor’s degree in a related domain, preferably in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics.
  • Minimum of 10 - 12 years of experience in roles such as Credit Underwriting, MIS Reporting, Credit Policy, or Credit Analytics; preferably with managerial experience of at least 2+ year.
  • Strong analytical skills with a capacity to collect, organize, and analyze vast amounts of data with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Comprehensive understanding of the retail banking customer credit life cycle, including origination and portfolio management; with prior experience in consumer lending (preferably credit cards/ personal loans/ Buy now pay later).
  • Self-driven, independent learner with a keen interest in team collaboration.
  • Detail-oriented and efficient time manager who thrives in a rapidly changing and dynamic working environment.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in verbal and written communication.
  • Prior hands-on experience with Python will be a distinct advantage.


Good To Have

  • Advanced technical expertise concerning credit risk models, database management, and segmentation techniques.
  • High Proficiency level in English.

rows.title: Platinion Senior IT Architect
rows.description:
What You'll Do

We are looking for experienced Technology Consultants (Architecture) to further grow BCG's thought leadership, capabilities and enablement. These are exciting opportunities to apply a strategic problem-solving lens to your passion for technology, digital and innovation.* Work cohesively with hybrid case teams consisting of BCG/DigitalBCG on general IT, digital/technology transformation projects* Provide technology advisory services to clients across various industry sectors* Align business and technology strategies to deliver impactful insights and outcomes jointly with client management* Assess current state technology landscape, define target state and develop transition roadmaps* Assist, define and drive implementation of technical architectures and proof of concepts* Design innovative technology solutions across various projects/clients to solve complex business problems* Analyse complex and high-risk IT solutions, often coupled with optimization of the full software delivery lifecycle* Facilitate workshops with clients to identify and formulate business and IT requirements for key vendor/system selections or innovation topics* Drive innovation for our clients by leveraging cross-industry views on technology trends* Actively network, manage and influence multiple client and stakeholder relationship groups including senior executives.


What You'll Bring

  • 3-6 years' experience in a strategy, management or technology consultancy and/or industry* Experience working within an architecture domain (solutions, applications or big data)* Understanding of architecture principles and exposure to architecting modern data platforms* Broad generalist digital/technology skills and knowledge* Good understanding of emerging digital/tech topics and trends across various industries* Thrive in a hypothesis-based environment and ability to frame strategic challenges from a digital/tech perspective* Strong analytical skills, problem solving ability and conceptual thinking* Excellent communication, storylining, client facing and consulting skills* Strategic mindset, presence and gravitas* Minimum of a bachelor's degree preferably in an IT/Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline* Flexibility to travel within SEA/Asia Pacific region (once restrictions allow).

rows.title: Expert Consultant, Chemicals
rows.description:
What You'll Do

As a Consultant, you will be part of and collaborate in BCG project teams consisting of high performing members with different backgrounds, conduct detailed fact-based analyses and develop state of the art strategic solutions. As an Expert affiliated to the chemical sector, you will be a core member of BCG's Energy and Industrial practices working alongside some of the world's top minds in the industry. Following your expertise you will also significantly contribute to the development of our chemical clients, and support their ambitious growth targets. You will work on some of the most important players in the chemical industry in SEA, partnering with Operators, Governments and Service Companies. The majority of your time will be spent leading and developing BCG teams composed of members of different backgrounds collaborating with you on those projects. You will also dedicate time to further develop and deepen BCG's expertise in chemical, and to support BCG Partners in business development initiatives.


  • Play a leading role in the growth of our chemical clients through case leadership and execution, client development, and intellectual property & product creation
  • Develop, manage and maintain client relationships in the chemical sector
  • Lead and provide expertise and support to chemical transformation projects within the oil & gas and petrochemical sectors for our key clients in Southeast Asia
  • Work jointly with BCG and client project teams, bringing expertise to the team and to the client on site
  • Provide intellectual leadership for the project teams by generating key ideas and conceptual frameworks to guide research and analysis
  • Actively support our business development efforts in client meetings and industry conferences
  • Contribute to the creation of BCG's intellectual capital on the topic by positioning papers, studies, insights from case experience, tools and products
  • Dedicate time to develop own and BCG's expertise by developing and driving the content agenda to the next level* Provide mentorship and support to consultants ensuring continuous individual development


Our Expert Consulting Track

The Expert Consulting Track (ECT) is vital to BCG’s ability to successfully meet our clients’ demand for deep expertise and advanced technical capabilities. Experts deliver next-level impact for BCG's most complex and cutting-edge client challenges. Experts focus on developing BCG's thought leadership, commercial capabilities, and intellectual property assets; and their work is essential to our delivery model. Working as part of a multidisciplinary team to bring the ‘best of BCG’ to our clients, Experts come from diverse backgrounds, with expertise often gained outside of BCG in industry, academia, or specialized consulting.


What You'll Bring

YOUR PROFILE

  • Strong academics, preferably as a chemical engineer
  • Master or MBA degree required from a top-tier institution
  • A minimum 6 years' experience in the chemical industry, or a combination of industry and consulting experience in the chemical sector
  • Experience working with/for well-functioning, advanced global businesses in the chemical sector
  • Deep understanding of the chemical value chains, market trends, key applications
  • Experience either in chemical plant Operations, Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), or Marketing & Males
  • Experience either in basic chemicals / intermediates or derivatives / specialties
  • Experience running large programs, transforming business units e.g. cost optimization, digital strategy in companies in the chemical sector
  • Experience in managing teams and large assignments end-to-end in the chemical sector


Professional Skills

  • Excellent communication and persuasion skills to interact at high levels and manage stakeholders
  • Strong business sense
  • Analytical and structured with excellent problem solving skills (hypothesis driven approach etc.)
  • Advanced quantitative analysis skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English (South East Asian languages would be desirable, but not essential)
  • Excellent track record of project/team leadership and related achievements


PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • Flexible, curious and creative, open for new things and able to propose innovative ideas
  • Independent and autonomous judgment* Collaborative team player and positive attitude
  • Intercultural competence and experience of working in more than one country and/or multi-cultural teams
  • Driven, hard-working, entrepreneurial, proactive and productive
  • Highest ethical standard
  • Willingness to travel internationally and to work remotely on client sites

rows.title: Principal, Financial Institution Practice

What You'll Do

BCG SEA is looking for Project Leaders, Principals or Partners for our Financial Institutions Practice, who will partner with clients to take on their most difficult challenges, transform mind-sets, create outstanding value, and build capabilities that enable organizations to achieve sustainable advantage.You will:

  • Play a key role on client engagements, managing studies to define client needs and supervising research activities to obtain relevant data.
  • Be responsible for managing project teams comprised of consultants who design and develop innovative long-term business strategies for client corporations that maximize the return on the investment of shareholders.
  • Oversee the formulation of hypotheses for research and investigation, and the advanced financial analysis of client, competitor, and industry data.
  • Apply knowledge of business principles and industrial organization, develop actionable recommendations, and supervise work including strategic due diligence, product development studies, change management plans, and the evaluation of long-term investment opportunities.
  • Be responsible for managing client contact and play a key role in the development and maintenance of high-level client relationships.
  • Act as a key topic content lead for proposals or other business development work.


What You'll Bring

We're looking for exceptional talent from consulting or industry to join us. You would typically have:

  • Strong academics from a top-tier institution.
  • A minimum of 10-12 years of work experience in strategy consulting and demonstrated experience managing a team.
  • Experience from solving complex business problems and devising business strategies, through formulating research and/or analytical approaches involving quantitative analysis, conceptualization, and communication of strategic solutions.
  • Excellent communication and persuasion skills and written and spoken English.
  • Excellent numerical skills, analytical and structured with the potential to conduct advanced quantitative analysis.
  • Solid business acumen, commercial capabilities and business judgement* Team player, open and positive in a group dynamic


Additional info

WHAT CAN A CAREER AT BCG OFFER YOU?

  • An opportunity to innovate and change: We have a legacy of developing deep insights and game-changing ideas and our case teams take ideas from all levels in order to deliver breakthrough insights to our clients.
  • Training and mentoring: We embed mentorship and apprenticeship throughout your time at BCG. You will have a support system of career development advisors, the guidance of project leaders, and partnership with your colleagues and teammates at every turn.
  • A collaborative approach: You will join a growing team of talented individuals, operating and learning from people with a diverse and broad set of backgrounds.

We're looking for exceptional talent from consulting or industry to join us. You would typically have:

What You'll Do

Payments revenue globally is poised to expand by 5.9% annually through 2028, maintaining a growth streak that started after the 2008 recession and adding about $1.0 trillion to the payments revenue pool-raising the total to roughly $2.5 trillion. But attaining growth above GDP levels will be difficult for established players. To gain or maintain leading market positions, they must accelerate digitization, gain scale, and realize the potential of developing markets.


As an Expert Project Leader, you will play a key role in the development of our Payments topic as well as support our growth targets across Southeast Asia. Additionally, you will be expected to:

  • Advise clients on executive level across countries and industries supporting them to improve or transform their businesses and achieve excellence in what they do, as we work to deliver lasting impact in a highly dynamic environment.
  • Lead BCG project teams enabling them to find the right approach, motivate them to deliver on time and to achieve long-term impact for our clients. You will also drive the majority of the project related client interactions ensuring a constructive collaboration with our clients.
  • Build and spread payments expertise within BCG and serving as a Payments expert for the firm to develop new techniques and/or capture new ideas as well as casework experience.

Our Expert Consulting Track

The Expert Consulting Track (ECT) is vital to BCG’s ability to successfully meet our clients’ demand for deep expertise and advanced technical capabilities. Experts deliver next-level impact for BCG's most complex and cutting-edge client challenges. Experts focus on developing BCG's thought leadership, commercial capabilities, and intellectual property assets; and their work is essential to our delivery model. Working as part of a multidisciplinary team to bring the ‘best of BCG’ to our clients, Experts come from diverse backgrounds, with expertise often gained outside of BCG in industry, academia, or specialized consulting.


What You'll Bring

We're looking for exceptional talent from consulting or industry to join us. You would typically have:

  • Broad, hands-on experience in Payments and Transaction Banking with a track record of project/team leadership and related achievements.

What you’ll Do:

As a (Lead/Manager) Identity Access Management (IAM) you are responsible for:

  • Lead the management of user identities and access privileges within the organization's systems and applications.
  • Drive the implementation and maintenance of the IAM framework, policies, and procedures.
  • Oversee user onboarding, offboarding, and access revocation processes.

  • Conduct periodic access reviews and audits to ensure compliance with security standards.
  • Lead the monitoring of user access activities and investigate security incidents or access violations.

  • Collaborate with IT teams to integrate IAM solutions with existing systems and applications.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of comprehensive authentication methods and related protocols.
  • Develop user access matrix from scratch, considering the organization's structure and access needs.
  • Implement segregation of duty controls to ensure compliance and reduce security risks.
  • Understand the technical architecture required to integrate with IAM System, Single Sign-On (SSO) system, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Key Management System (KMS), and sophisticated access management systems.


What you’ll need:

  • 8+ years of work experience in Identity Access Management roles, preferably in banking or payment companies.
  • Strong understanding of information security fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with network security and information systems security principles.
  • In-depth understanding of identity and access management concepts, principles, and frameworks.
  • Extensive experience in administering IAM tools and technologies.
  • Analytical mindset and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to handle sensitive information securely.
  • Proven track record in designing and implementing robust cryptography key management systems.
  • Successful development and implementation of comprehensive IAM governance frameworks.
  • Experience in conducting access reviews, audits, and delivering IAM training programs.
  • Demonstrated expertise in comprehensive authentication methods and related protocols.
  • Proven ability to develop user access matrices from scratch.
  • Experience implementing segregation of duty controls.
  • In-depth understanding of the technical architecture needed for integration with IAM System, SSO, MFA, PAM, KMS, and sophisticated access management systems.


It would be great if you have:

  • Security, audit, and compliance-related certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISA, CRISC).
  • Expertise in multi-factor authentication methods and implementation.
  • Deep familiarity with identity lifecycle management and role-based access control concepts.
  • Experience with industry regulations and compliance standards relevant to the organization.
  • Strong project management skills to lead IAM initiatives and coordinate with stakeholders.

rows.title: Assistant IT Manager
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As the IT Manager, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

IT

  • Maximize and protect hotel profitability through the leverage of Information Technology, training and operational best practices.
  • Maximize opportunities to reduce IT costs through effective purchasing and negotiating maintenance contracts.
  • Identify and propose opportunities to optimize revenue.
  • Responsible for timely preparation and submission of all IT budgets.
  • Responsible for the management and control of all IT expense according to an agreed plan.
  • Ensure a business continuity plan is established and tested for all parts of the business.
  • Provide the highest possible IT service to the agreed standards and best practices.
  • Work with Business Management to expedite access and better utilization of information.
  • Implement and exploit telephony services to HI minimum defined standards.
  • Ensure guests’ IT queries are managed to defined standards with minimal risks.
  • Ensure brand standards are communicated and maintained for Guest and Business Service.
  • Ensure the hotel adopts and maintains brand standards for guests and business services in relation to IT services and offerings.
  • Consistently promote the brand and encourage the use of the brand by IT suppliers.
  • Ensure IT resources are maintained in the hotel to support the commercial & business needs.
  • Identify and ensure all hotel data has ownership and accountability within the organization.
  • Ensure a successor is identified and trained to the standard.
  • Provide IT support to other Hilton hotels when required.
  • Cross train other hotel IT personnel to provide cover.
  • Maintain standards and best practices in the hotel and evaluate compliance
  • Manage and monitor local vendors and / or local representatives of global / area vendors.
  • Ensure that hotel data is secured and in line with stated standards and best practices.
  • Ensure Access Control is in line with stated standards and best practices.
  • Ensure regular self-evaluations of IT practices are completed and communicated.
  • Manage local implementation projects.
  • Communicate status, risks, opportunities to GM, hotel management and regional and area IT management.
  • Adhere to the hotel’s security and emergency policies and procedures.
  • Ensure that all team members have a complete understanding of and adhere to the hotel’s team member rules and regulations.
  • The Management reserves the right to change / extend this job description if necessary, at any point of time during her / his employment.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Purchasing

  • Follow hotel purchasing policy and procedures when carrying out of all purchases.
  • Obtain three competitive quotes from suppliers to minimize cost to hotel.
  • Conduct interviews with suppliers, representatives and obtain information, specification, quotations on any items required, handling subsequent correspondence and negotiations for procurement.
  • Place orders with suppliers to ensure timely delivery to satisfy hotel requirement and trace the outstanding orders to ensure operational needs are met.
  • Check pricing of purchase orders and determine appropriate suppliers to obtain best quality and price.
  • Conduct market surveys to understand market trends and the price floating.
  • Safeguard the petty cash float (if any) so as to ensure no unauthorized access to the float, ensuring that it is kept in the safe.
  • Collect the Market List quotation at regular intervals.
  • Regularly review contract supplies to ensure prices are still competitive.
  • Maintain competitor knowledge of similar products by regularly surveying price lists of other hotels’ operation supplies.
  • Analyze market trends to anticipate likely price fluctuations, for the purpose of maintaining inventory either for long or short time periods.
  • Ensure all documentation (purchase orders, invoices, delivery dockets etc.) is forwarded to Accounts Payable on a timely basis.
  • Flexible in relation to work hours.
  • Minimize the risk of accidents and workers’ compensation costs by ensuring the correct work practices are used and that the area is safe from hazards.
  • Handle all requests and enquiries in a timely, efficient and friendly manner.
  • Strictly follow the code of conduct.
  • The Management reserves the right to change / extend this job description if necessary, at any point of time during her / his employment.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.


What are we looking for?

An Assistant IT Manager serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Three to Five years of relevant IT management experience.
  • At least 1 year of working experience as Purchaser or higher in the hospitality industry.
  • Sound technical understanding of the management of IT in a service organization.
  • Good personality to deal with guests.
  • Capable of training team members.
  • Possess strong project management and presentation skills.
  • IT qualification / training.
  • Able to communicate in both spoken and written English, to meet business needs, is desirable.
  • Knowledge of supplies management.
  • Experience in similar capacity with international chain hotels.
  • Working experience within Hilton Group is advantageous.

rows.title: Manager, Financial Risk Management
rows.description:
Key Accountabilities:


  • Support Head of Department (HoD) in implementing and ensuring compliance with the local Risk Management Framework, Risk Policies and standards, consistent with local regulatory requirement / Internal Risk Frameworks and Risk Policies
  • Support HoD in identifying, assessing and monitoring the financial risk exposures (i.e. credit, market, liquidity and insurance risk) against local risk appetite and limits  
  • Monitor key risk indicators of Financial Risk
  • Provide support of risk-based decision making on:
  • Product development and pricing. This includes liaising with the key stakeholders to ensure the products (e.g. features, the pricing elements and other conditions) create value within the risk appetite, review the product risks and articulate the risks to the local stakeholders regarding to the product risk identification, assessment and management policies
  • Reinsurance arrangements and any other risk transfer / hedging arrangements
  • Strategic asset allocation, investment strategy
  • Strategic and business planning
  • Capital management and any other material business decisions
  • Assist the development and implementation of local risk appetite framework
  • Provide support on the annual risk identification and various Stress Testing exercises
  • Develop effective working relationships with all key stakeholders e.g. Finance & Actuarial, Investment managers and Group colleagues. 
  • Prepare the key financial risks related materials to the risk committees via the risk management pack
  • Meet any ad hoc risk management initiatives from the Group, local regulators and other stakeholders


Minimum requirements: 


  • A bachelor’s degree in Actuarial, Financial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or other related fields
  • Good progress or qualification in SOA or relevant certification (FRM, CFA, PRM, etc) is preferable
  • Minimum of 4-years experiences of life insurance with at least 2 years in product development / pricing, solvency framework and/or other relevant areas.
  • Familiar with Local Solvency Framework, financial reporting, European Embedded Value (EEV)
  • General knowledge/ experience in financial market will be an asset
  • Must be able to effectively work independently as well as in a team
  • Good command in written and spoken English
  • Good command in MS Office
  • Strong analytical skills and problem solving

rows.title: Head of Enterprise Risk Management & GRC
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Risk Management Leadership

• Lead the development and implementation of an integrated ERM framework that aligns with the group’s business strategy and regulatory requirements.

• Ensure the ERM framework accommodates diverse risks including strategic, operational, financial, and compliance risks.

GRC Implementation and Governance

• Formulate and enforce robust GRC policies across all subsidiaries, ensuring comprehensive communication and adherence throughout the organization

• Lead the continuous identification of potential risks through thorough assessments, leveraging insights to develop and implement effective mitigation strategies.

• Stay abreast of regulatory developments affecting the financial and fintech sectors, ensuring that all group operations remain compliant with evolving laws and standards,

Training and Development

• Establish a training program on ERM and Risk Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) for risk managers and other key personnel within the group.

• Promote a risk-aware culture throughout the organization through continuous education and training.

Due Diligence on ERM and Risk Advisory Projects

• Conduct due diligence focusing on the ERM and compliance capabilities of potential partnership targets or acquisition candidates.

• Advise on risk implications in potential mergers and acquisitions.

• Lead and manage risk advisory projects to enhance risk management practices at all levels of the organization.


If you meet below qualifications and are ready to take on a challenging role, we encourage you to apply.


• Minimum 15 years’ experience in risk management roles within the financial services.

• Expertise in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), especially in strategic planning, process design, training, and fostering an organizational culture in GRC

• Proven experience in leading risk management, compliance, or related teams. Experience managing cross-functional teams and projects is particularly valuable.

• Familiarity with financial regulations and standards both locally in Thailand and internationally.

• Relevant professional certifications such as Certified Risk Manager (CRM), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)

rows.title: Financial Risk Management
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive risk management policies and procedures in line with regulatory requirements, including BASEL and BOT regulations.
  • Conduct regular financial risk assessments with focuses on liquidity risk and interest rate risk including the extension to scenario analyses of dynamic financial position for management’s decision making.
  • Perform stress testing and undertake Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (ICAAP) to evaluate the potential impact of adverse scenarios on the organization's financial health.
  • Coordinate the development and execution of recovery plans and liquidity contingency plans to ensure organizational resilience in crisis situations.
  • Develop and maintain a risk appetite framework and set clear guidelines for capital and market risk tolerance levels.
  • Oversee the asset-liability management (ALM) process to ensure balance sheet management activities are in alignment with the organization's risk appetite.
  • Work closely with the compliance team to ensure adherence to all relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies.
  • Collaborate with various departments to integrate risk management principles into business strategies and operations.
  • Provide regular reports to senior management and the board on the organization's risk profile, risk management activities, and compliance status.
  • Stay abreast of emerging risks, regulatory changes, and industry best practices in financial risk management.


If you meet below qualifications and are ready to take on a challenging role, we encourage you to apply.


  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field. An advanced degree (e.g., MBA) is preferred.
  • Professional certification in risk management, such as the FRM (Financial Risk Manager) certificate.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in financial risk management, preferably in the banking or financial services industry.
  • Strong knowledge of and high familiarity with financial institution related regulations, including BASEL and BOT regulations.
  • Proficient in risk assessment methodologies, stress testing, and ALM techniques.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to various stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in risk management software and tools.

The Backend Engineer is responsible for the system to work behind the scenes. rows.title: Head of Grants & Partnerships
rows.description:
Duties And Responsibilities

Program Development

  • In coordination with the DDP and Country Director, cultivate donor relationships and identify new public and private funding opportunities. Monitor major donor trends and funding opportunities through regular research and monitoring of information on relevant websites and/or other sources.
  • Support program growth aligned with strategic priorities in IRC Myanmar’s Business Development Plan and through collaborating with respective technical sectors in program design, researching context, gaps, needs assessments, and viable new funding opportunities.

  • Ensure the identification, appraisal, and mapping of partners is carried out in a consistent manner, and that partners are appropriately engaged in pre-positioning and proposal development processes.

Grants Management

  • Ensure the submission of timely and high-quality reports (including narrative, financial and MEAL) to donors, including the situation reports, and maintain update of regular funding and reporting trackers and schedules for dissemination to relevant staff.
  • Responsible for updating and timely dissemination of funding and donor reporting grid/schedule to relevant staff. Ensure the submission of timely and high-quality reports to donors.
  • Raise compliance issues proactively with program staff and the SMT for timely action and keep senior management and regional focal points informed of any projected inabilities to meet contractual obligations, reports submission and of spend rates/signification budget variances.
  • Coordinate with Project Leads to organize regular project cycle meetings and follow up with different departments (Programs, Finance, Supply Chain, etc.) on action points and pending issues to ensure proper grant management.
  • Maintain a strong working relationship with donors. Participate in donor meetings together with the CD and/or DDP as required.

Partnerships

  • Oversee the partnership team and serve as a leader in building a culture of effective, respectful and equal partnerships. Foster and promote attitudes and values conducive to collaborative partnerships across the country program’s functional departments based on a clear and shared understanding of IRC’s strategy, approach, and core partnership principles.

This includes coaching, training, and mentoring direct-report staff, communicating clear expectations, setting annual performance objectives, providing regular and timely positive and constructive performance feedback, and providing documented annual performance reviews.

Requirements

Major Responsibilities

  • Serve as the focal point for all activities related to camp water supply and treatment, sanitation and waste management, and vector control in the camp.

  • Supervise the operations, maintenance, and enhancement of the water system and infrastructure, including sedimentation systems, small-scale check dams, pumping stations, water treatment facilities, and distribution pipelines within the camp.
  • Record essential data from the water system for analysis to ensure quality standards are met and to identify areas for improvement.
  • In coordination with Community Health Officer, monitor household water information to include water consumption (liters/person/day) and quality, as well as household sanitation data to include latrine coverage, waste disposal habits and existence of vectors.
  • Supervise construction or maintain household toilet and public toilet, ensure that following the standard required.
  • Supervise the operation of solid waste management and maintenance of solid waste infrastructure, including solid waste collection points, disposal pits, and high-temperature incinerators.
  • Lead the implementation of the 3Rs principle (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle) and organize waste separation campaigns. Conduct training sessions for camp residents to promote sustainable waste management practices and environmental awareness.
  • Supervise activities related to WASH in health facilities to ensure that Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) measures are implemented effectively and maintained at high standards. This includes providing training and conducting IPC assessment on bi-annually basis.
  • In coordination with the Community Health Officer, ensure that vector control, disease surveillance and outbreak control activities are properly targeted and implemented.
  • In collaboration with Community Health Worker team, assist in implementing annually KAP survey.
  • Serve as technical advisor and focal point for all IRC construction related activities and maintenance of IRC facilities in Ban Don Yang Camp.
  • Collect data and maintain records related to camp sanitation systems.
  • Participate in WASH/EH meetings, providing necessary information and updates. Additionally, participate in or support training sessions related to WASH/EH topics, ensuring effective communication and knowledge sharing within the team and with relevant stakeholders.
  • Assist and support the Senior Health Manager as necessary in monitoring EH program budgets and spending plan to ensure expenditures are on track and utilized requirements and regulations.
  • Initiate procurement to ensure adequate supplies of chemicals, fuels, lubricants and spare parts for water supply/treatment systems and sanitation activities are maintained in local stocks.
  • Write routine progress reports and keep supervisor informed on the water and sanitation situation in the camp.
  • Assist with any other duties as requested by supervisor.


Job Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor of water supply, sanitation or construction engineering, public health and Environmental Health education is a plus
  • Work Experience: Minimum 3 years working experience working in Environmental Health in a refugee setting or in developing country is plus

Demonstrated Skills And Competencies

  • Knowledge and experience in waste management, water treatment processes, water quality monitoring, excreta disposal, solid waste, and vector control activities
  • Construction skills (concrete, wood and brick construction and soil mechanics)
  • Capable of training and motivating community support
  • Experience supervising personnel.
  • Competent in Windows, MS office programs, emails, and relevant health databases (HMIS, DHIS etc.).
  • Experience in environmental health / WASH services delivery and ability to develop WASH activities from a community development approach; experience in monitoring and supervision of WASH / EH activities.
  • Experience in working with multicultural staff and ability to work with sizeable multi-cultural team delivering assistance involving a wide array of program stakeholders.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Experience in implementation of communicable disease outbreaks investigations and response is an advantage.
  • Professional demeanors.

rows.title: Senior Manager/Director of Freight Forwarding Business Process, Southeast Asia – Thailand (Bangkok)
rows.description:
Key Accountabilities

  • Effectively managing the Freight Forwarding company acquired by the cluster.
  • Identify, analyze, and improve existing business processes to increase efficiency and productivity.
  • Align acquired company’s business processes with the overall strategic goals and objectives of DP World.
  • Work closely with Vice President of Freight Forwarding and Global Executive Vice President of Freight Forwarding and respective countries to ensure that process improvements support the company's long-term vision.
  • Collaborate with different departments and teams (Operations and Commercial teams to understand their processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Identify and implement technology solutions that support and enhance business processes.
  • Ensure that technology is leveraged effectively to automate and optimize processes.
  • Lead and facilitate change management initiatives related to process improvements.
  • Communicate changes effectively to stakeholders and ensure smooth transitions.
  • Develop training programs for employees to ensure that they understand and follow optimized processes.
  • Provide ongoing support and education to teams on new processes and tools.
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with business processes.
  • Implement controls and measures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
  • Continuously monitor the performance of business processes and gather feedback from stakeholders.
  • Use feedback to make iterative improvements and adjustments to processes as needed.
  • Ensure that business processes adhere to relevant regulations and compliance standards.
  • Establish and enforce governance mechanisms to maintain process integrity.


Qualifications, Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Logistics, Freight Forwarding, Supply Chain Management, or a related field
  • Minimum 7-10 years of extensive experience in freight forwarding operations, including understanding of international trade regulations, customs procedures, documentation requirements, and industry best practices.
  • Prior experience in managing the post-integration of acquired companies into the existing organization will be a bonus
  • Strong project management skills to oversee the integration process, set timelines, allocate resources, and ensure successful execution within defined parameters.
  • Proficiency in developing integration plans to align processes, systems, and operations between the acquiring company and the acquired company. This includes identifying synergies, streamlining operations, and optimizing resources.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively interact with internal teams, external partners, and customers.
  • Strong adaptability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and timelines.

  • Strong presentation skills, the ability to simplify complex technical concepts, and a customer-focused mindset are crucial for success in this role.
  • Excellent consultative and relationship management skills.
  • Proven strong customer pipeline planning skills and experience.
  • Excellent communications and negotiation skills
  • Good problem-solving skills.
  • Leadership and collaboration skills are essential for effective teamwork.
  • Process driven and pro-active with the ability to manage priorities, be organised, methodical and deal well under pressure.

  • Relevant Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Business Administration, Shipping / Logistics Management, or equivalent disciplines.
  • Minimum 10-15 years of extensive experience in supply chain management, product development, and solutions design, preferably from Beneficial Cargo Owner (BCO) or logistics industries.
  • Proven leadership experience in managing teams, preferably in a regional or global context.
  • Strong background in the logistics industry, with a focus on Southeast Asia.
  • Ability to develop and execute a strategic vision for the supply chain products and solutions in alignment with business objectives.

rows.title: Sales Executive/Managers
rows.description:
Key Accountabilities

  • Responsible for achieving the stipulated sales target set by DP World.
  • Actively seek out new sales opportunities by identifying and targeting potential customers. This involves researching industries, markets, and leads to find new prospects.
  • Actively seek out and generate leads through various means such as cold calling, email campaigns, networking events, and referrals.
  • Create and deliver persuasive sales presentations and proposals to potential customers.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing/new BCOs to understand their evolving needs, address concerns, and ensure client satisfaction to secure repeat business.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the logistics solutions and services provided by DP World.
  • Collaborate with BCOs to design tailored logistics solutions that align with their specific requirements and business objectives.
  • Negotiate pricing, contracts, and terms with BCOs to secure profitable and mutually beneficial agreements.
  • Stay informed about logistics industry trends, competitive services, and market conditions.
  • Stay updated on industry regulations and compliance requirements, especially when dealing with international logistics and transportation.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams in the DP World, such as operations and customer service, to ensure the successful execution of contracts and customer satisfaction.


Qualifications, Skills and Experience

  • Tertiary qualifications with minimum 5 years’ sales/business development experience in Logistics/Freight-forwarding.
  • Solid and demonstrated working knowledge of the Freight Forwarding Industry.
  • Effective verbal and written communications in English and interpersonal skills. Ability to communicate with clients, carriers, other forwarders, vendors.
  • Ability to research, identify, tackle, grow and close business opportunities ensuring the needed support from product and operations.
  • Results-driven, proactive, and able to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Great negotiation, consultative and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to manage priorities, be organised, methodical and deal well under pressure.

  • ป้อนยาและอาหาร

rows.title: Graduate Electrical Engineer
rows.description:
Job Descriptions

  • Responsible for assisting the engineering design team in design and development of electrical power and communication systems for commercial buildings, Industrial sector, and/or Infrastructure work.
  • Collaborate with other design disciplines locally and regionally for deliverables achievement in the design of electrical systems and components for assigned projects.
  • Prepare and develop project documentation for submission, including drawings, designed calculations, technical specifications, and reports to meet the clients’ procedures, relevant standards, and requirements.
  • Keen to work productively and coordinate activities on numerous projects concurrently.
  • Ability to work as part of a team to meet deliverables deadlines.


Job Requirements

  • Electrical Engineering Bachelor’s degree or higher
  • Minimum 2-3 years of working experience for electrical power and/or communication system design in commercial building, industrial sector and/or infrastructure work.
  • Knowledge of detailed drawing production process and relevant electrical system calculation provisions with applicable standards and codes.
  • Ability to read and understand basically architectural and structural drawing or E&M system design drawings.
  • Able to use Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software to deliver electrical designs and markups
  • Time-management skills to meet deliverables schedule required.
  • Ability to collaborate and communicate with internal and other reginal office teams.

Software Experience Requirements

  • AutoCAD skills
  • Microsoft Office skills
  • Basic Revit MEP skills

The Opportunity

  • Supporting the Electrical Design Engineers and Engineering Team as part of our multi-disciplinary project teams to work on exciting projects such as Changi T5, Singapore MRT projects.
  • Creating 3D model the Electrical Engineering Design Electrical Equipment Layout for buildings electrical works in AUTODESK Revit software.
  • Preparing Single Line Diagrams, Control Schematics, Plan and Elevation drawings, for the electrical works in AUTOCAD.
  • Ability to understand the electrical engineering concepts and prepare the drawings with minimum guidance and based on high level hand sketches or explanations.
  • Ability to Prepare the drawings related to other disciplines such as Mechanical and Plumbing & Civil drawings will be an added advantage.


About You

  • Degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering.
  • At least 3 years of 3D modelling experience of Electrical design for buildings and metro projects in AUTODESK Revit Software.
  • Experience in preparing the 2D drawings in AUTOCAD for related buildings and metro works.
  • Ability to read/write and understand/speak English.
  • Proactive, team player with good interpersonal skills.
  • Collaborating with other team members (both locally and globally), across disciplines and sectors.

company.name: Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc
company.introduction: Hilton Hotels & Resorts is a global brand of full-service hotels and resorts and the flagship brand of American multinational hospitality company Hilton.

rows.title: Guest Service Agent
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As the Guest Service Agent, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Complete the registration process by inputting and retrieving information from a computer system, confirming pertinent information including number of guests and room rates.
  • Make appropriate selection of rooms based on guests’ needs, code electronic keys, confirms the room number and rates with a written confirmation.
  • Promote and administer Hilton marketing programs such as Hilton Honors for arriving guests, ensuring guests know the location of rooms containing room keys, tokens of our appreciation, gifts, etc., to guests.
  • Ensure rooms and services are correctly accounted for within guests’ statements, properly stating services provided by the hotel.
  • Assist guests with check-out payments or charges, accepting and recording vouchers, credits, traveller’s checks and other forms of payment, converting foreign currency at current posted rates.
  • Greet customers immediately with a friendly and sincere welcome with a positive and clear speaking voice, listen and understand requests, respond with appropriate actions and provide accurate information such on outlet hours, special VIP programs, events, etc.
  • Receive special requests from guests and respond appropriately or forward requests to appropriate team members for their decisions and actions.
  • Promptly answer the telephone and email inquiries, inputting messages into the computer and advising other team members of special guests’ needs.
  • Retrieve messages and communicate the content to guests, retrieving mail, packages and facsimiles or other special items for customers as requested.
  • Record guests’ complaints, conducting thorough research to develop the most effective solution and negotiate results.
  • Listen and extend assistance in order to resolve problems such as price conflicts, insufficient heating or air conditioning, quality of dishes etc.
  • Remain calm and alert especially during emergency situations and heavy hotel activity.
  • Plan and implement detailed steps by using experienced judgment and discretion.
  • Take on an active role in the team by being kind, cooperative, and helpful and never forgetting the person behind the guest.
  • Actively take part in training where and when required, attending formal training sessions and on the job trainings to ensure standards and develop skills and abilities.
  • Contribute to the hotel and team by sharing new ideas and suggestions for improvements, being innovative and creative to provide quality service and customer care to team members and guests.
  • Take on an active role in the Executive Floor team, ensuring effective communication and working as a team in order to reach goals and targets.
  • Create a warm and welcoming arrival for guests, ensuring that they feel expected and immediately “at-home” when they arrive.
  • Check-in guests in accordance with their reservation details, ensuring that the registration cards are completed, reservation information confirmed, Hilton Honours and Frequent Flyer numbers enquired about, and method of payment is secured.


What are we looking for?

A Guest Service Agent serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Able to perform moderately complex mathematical calculations without error.
  • Able to read, listen and communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing to meet business needs.
  • Able to access and accurately input information using a moderately complex computer system.
  • Able to effectively deal with internal and external customers, some of whom will require high levels of patience, tact and diplomacy to defuse anger, collect accurate information and resolve conflicts.
  • Good interpersonal skills to provide overall guest satisfaction.
  • Able to work under pressure and deal with stressful situations during busy periods.
  • 1 or 2 years of related working experience preferred.

rows.title: Brand Design - Flavors
rows.description:
Responsibilities

Accountabilities are statements of the important end results which the job must achieve. These statements should relate to an end result or objective which must be accomplished and against which some measurement of performance can be applied.

The Brand Designer is responsible for the execution of brand design strategies and graphic design projects within our food & snacks portfolio, specifically for non-potato chip brands. The successful candidate will demonstrate superior ability to drive design quality, from concept development to refinement, and execution.

Takes ownership of the visual identity for specific brands in the portfolio, working in collaboration with the Design Manager, Design Director, brand teams and marketing.

They work closely with global GSG for approvals and collaboration.

Generate creative design proposals (visions, scenarios, concepts) in order to visualize the desired output and share it with internal and external team members.

Participates in research activities and effectively translates customer needs into actionable design requirements, and apply those requirements into design solutions. Responsible for driving to final design recommendations, decisions and design approval to enable artwork execution / production phases.

Ensures thorough consideration of all project variables and that the final solution will perform as planned.

  • Outstanding design portfolio
  • International experience
  • Fluent in English, spoken and written
  • Proven design team leader
  • 5+ years of brand design experience
  • Graphic design degree or equivalent
  • Tangible understanding of digital ecosystem
  • Extraordinary design taste and skill
  • Extraordinary ability in using the Adobe Creative Suite software ( 3D software is a Plus)
  • Works well under pressure.

rows.title: Secretary Support Associate
rows.description:
Job Responsibility

1. สนับสนุน และอำนวยความสะดวกเพื่อรับรองผู้บริหารและที่ปรึกษา ทั้งชาวไทยและชาวต่างชาติ ในงานประชุม งานพิธีการ งานสังคมและงานเฉพาะกิจต่างๆ ทั้งภายในและภายนอกบริษัท

2. ประสานงานกับหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง ทั้งภายในและภายนอกองค์กรเกี่ยวกับการจัดสิทธิประโยชน์และสวัสดิการต่างๆ ให้กับผู้บริหารและที่ปรึกษา เช่น ประกันสังคม ประกันกลุ่ม กองทุนสำรองเลี้ยงชีพ เป็นต้น

3. ควบคุมและจัดการการบริการเกี่ยวกับสิทธิประโยชน์และสวัสดิการผู้บริหารและที่ปรึกษา

4. จัดทำเอกสาร หนังสือ และบันทึกต่าง ๆ ด้านสิทธิประโยชน์และสวัสดิการ

5. จัดทำเอกสารการเบิก จ่าย สิทธิประโยชน์และสวัสดิการต่าง ๆ เช่น ค่ารักษาพยาบาล ค่าเบี้ยเลี้ยง เป็นต้น

6. ประสาน และสนับสนุนงานกิจกรรม และ/หรือ งานพิธีการเฉพาะกิจต่างๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้องของผู้บริหารและที่ปรึกษา

7. รักษาและพัฒนามาตรฐานการรับรอง และการบริการในงานต่างๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับผู้บริหารและที่ปรึกษา

8. ปฏิบัติงานที่ได้รับมอบหมายจากผู้บังคับบัญชา ทั้งงานประจำ หรืองานโครงการที่เกี่ยวกับงานของสำนักเลขานุการบริษัท ในบริษัทและบริษัทย่อยตามที่ได้รับมอบหมายจากผู้บังคับบัญชา


Job Qualification

• ปริญญาตรีทางด้านศิลปศาสตร์ บริหารธุรกิจ โรงแรมและการท่องเที่ยว หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง

• มีประสบการณ์ในงานเลขานุการอย่างน้อย 4 ปี

• มีประสบการณ์งานด้านอุตสาหกรรม MICE จะได้รับการพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ

• มีความสามารถในการใช้ภาษาไทยและภาษาอังกฤษในระดับดี-ดีมาก

• มีทักษะการสื่อสารที่ดี ทำงานเป็นทีมกับบุคคลที่หลากหลายได้ และสามารถแก้ไขปัญหาเฉพาะหน้าได้ดี

• มีความแม่นยำ ละเอียดรอบคอบในขั้นตอนต่างๆ

• มีบุคลิกภาพดี มีมนุษย์สัมพันธ์ที่ดี สามารถติดต่อประสานงานทั้งภายในและภายนอกองค์กรอย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

• สนใจในการเพิ่มพูนความรู้ เรียนรู้ได้รวดเร็ว มีความเข้าใจที่จำเป็นเพื่อใช้ในการปฏิบัติหน้าที่ที่ได้รับมอบหมายได้อย่างทันเหตุการณ์และถูกต้องครบถ้วน

• รักษาความลับและเข้าใจระดับของการเปิดเผยข้อมูลเป็นอย่างดี ถูกต้องตามกฎหมายและกฎระเบียบ

Job Responsibility

- ดูแล จัดเก็บเอกสารสัญญาต่างๆ โดยเฉพาะสัญญาว่าจ้าง สัญญาต้ำประกัน หรือสัญญาอื่นๆ

- สร้างความพึ่งพอใจในการให้บริการจากผู้มาติดต่อ และให้ข้อมูลได้ถูกต้อง

- ดูแลสภาพแวดล้อมในการทำงาน (กิจกรรม 5ส) ความเรียบร้อยของการรับรอง ตรวจเช็คตารางการขอใช้ห้องประชุมในระบบให้เป็นไปตามแนวทางปฏิบัติ

- สรุปการเบิกค่ารับรองของ ผู้จัดการภาค ผู้ช่วยผู้จัดการภาค และผู้จัดการ ถูกต้องและส่งทันตามกำหนดเวลา

rows.title: เจ้าหน้าที่อาวุโสประสานงาน
rows.description:
Job Responsibility

งานด้านจดทะเบียนแจ้งเปลี่ยนแปลงต่างๆ กรณีบริษัทในกลุ่มไทยเบฟฯ มีความประสงค์แจ้งเปลี่ยนแปลง ซึ่งต้องแจ้งต่อสรรพากรในพื้นที่ที่บริษัทตั้งอยู่

1. ให้คำแนะนำกับเจ้าหน้าที่บัญชีในเรื่องความถูกต้องของเอกสารที่ต้องใช้แจ้งเปลี่ยนแปลง และเงื่อนเวลาในการดำเนินการ

2. อ่านงบการเงินและวิเคราะห์งบการเงินเบื้องต้น เพื่อตอบคำถามทางสรรพากร

3. ตรวจสอบเอกสารที่เจ้าหน้าที่บัญชีจัดเตรียมว่าถูกต้องตามระเบียบสรรพากรหรือไม่

4. เป็นผู้รับมอบอำนาจในการยื่นเอกสารจดทะเบียนแจ้งเปลี่ยนแปลงต่างๆ ต่อสรรพากร

5. ประสานงานติดตามเอกสารที่จะได้รับจากสรรพากรหลังการแจ้งจดทะเบียนเปลี่ยนแปลง เพื่อส่งให้เจ้าหน้าที่บัญชีต่อไป


งานด้านอื่นๆ

1. ให้บริการรับ - ส่ง และรับรองเจ้าหน้าที่สรรพากรในกรณีเจ้าหน้าที่สรรพากรเข้าตรวจสอบสถานประกอบการของบริษัท

2. ประสานงานและนำผลิตภัณฑ์ของบริษัทไปให้กับเจ้าหน้าที่สรรพากรที่ติดต่อในกรุงเทพฯ และปริมณฑล ในช่วงเทศกาลปีใหม่

3. งานอื่นๆ ตามที่ได้รับมอบหมายจากผู้บังคับบัญชา


Job Qualification

- จบการศึกษาปริญญาตรีขึ้นไป ด้านบัญชี หรืออื่นๆที่เกี่ยวข้อง

- มีประสบการณืในการประสานงานกับกรมสรรพากร หรือหน่วยงานราชการอย่างน้อย 2-3 ปี

- มีความละเอียดรอบคอบ

- มีทักษะการประสานงานในระดับ ดีมาก

rows.title: Administration & Documentation Officer
rows.description:
Job Responsibility

1. ดูแลจัดทำเอกสารค่าใช้จ่ายของงานบริหารอาคาร

2. จัดทำ PR ในระบบ SAP ค่าใช้จ่ายเกี่ยวกับอาคารหลังจากได้รับอนุมัติงบฯ

3. ประสานงานจัดซื้อแพนอินเตอร์ออก PO ในการจัดซื้อ/จัดจ้างผ่านระบบ SAP

4. ควบคุมดูแลจัดทำค่าใช้จ่ายที่เกี่ยวกับงานอาคารภายใต้งบประมาณที่ได้รับ

5. จัดทำเอกสารสั่งจ่ายที่เกี่ยวกับส่วนสำนักงาน ค่าเช่าพื้นที่ และค่าบริการสาธารณูปโภคต่าง ๆ

6. ดูแลจัดทำเอกสารค่าใช้จ่ายของงานบริหารทรัพย์สินอาคาร

7. จัดทำ PR ในระบบ SAP สั่งซื้อทรัพย์สินที่เกี่ยวข้องกับสำนักงาน

8. ประสานงานจัดซื้อแพนอินเตอร์ออก PO ในการจัดซื้อ/จัดจ้างผ่านระบบ SAP

9. ควบคุมดูแลจัดทำค่าใช้จ่ายที่เกี่ยวกับงานอาคารภายใต้งบประมาณที่ได้รับ

10. จัดทำเอกสารสั่งจ่ายที่เกี่ยวกับทรัพย์สินที่ตามรายการที่เปิด PR

11. ประสานงานเบิกน้ำดื่มให้กับสำนักงานในกลุ่มแต่ละอาคาร


Job Qualification

  • ปริญญาตรี สาขาการจัดการ หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • Professional Experiences(ประสบการณ์การทำงาน)
  • มีประสบการณ์ด้านงานธุรการ และประสานงานอย่างน้อย 2 ปี

rows.description:
Job Responsibility

  • ตรวจสอบความถูกต้องของรายงานการรับโมลาสของโรงงานสุราแต่ละแห่งที่ได้รับจากผู้ใต้บังคับบัญชา
  • ตรวจสอบข้อมูลการซื้อขายโมลาสจากระบบ SAP ประจำเดือนก่อนนำเสนอผู้บังคับบัญชา
  • วางแผนการส่งตัวอย่างโมลาสที่ได้รับจากโรงงานสุราแต่ละแห่ง ให้กับบริษัภายในและภายนอกที่รับตรวจสอบคุณภาพโมลาส
  • -ประเมินผลการตรวจสอบโมลาส ในกรณีที่คุณภาพของโมลาสต่ำกว่าเกณฑ์กำหนด
  • คำนวณค่าชดเชย (ค่าปรับ) ความหวานของโรงงานน้ำตาลแต่ละแห่ง ที่ต่ำกว่าเกณฑ์ที่กำหนดจากบริษัทภายนอก และรายงานให้กับผู้บังคับบัญชาทราบ
  • ประเมินผลการตรวจสอบโมลาส ในกรณีที่คุณภาพของโมลาสต่ำกว่าเกณฑ์กำหนด
  • คำนวณค่าชดเชย (ค่าปรับ) ความหวานของโรงงานน้ำตาลแต่ละแห่ง ที่ต่ำกว่าเกณฑ์ที่กำหนดจากบริษัทภายนอก และรายงานให้กับผู้บังคับบัญชาทราบ


Job Qualification

  • ปริญญาตรี ไม่จำกัดสาขา
  • มีความรู้ในเรื่องโมลาส (กากน้ำตาล) 4-6 ปีขึ้นไป
  • มีความสามารถในการเก็บรวบรวมข้อมูลที่เป็นประโยชน์ต่องาน
  • มีความสามารถในการเขียนสรุปรายงานได้ดี
  • มีความสามารถในการใช้โปรแกรม Microsoft Office (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel)
  • ทักษะการใช้โปรแกรม SAP

rows.title: ผู้ช่วยผู้จัดการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลจัดซื้อ
rows.description:
Job Responsibility

  • กำกับดูแลการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลการจัดซื้อให้มีความถูกต้อง และทันต่อความต้องการของธุรกิจเพื่อนำเสนอข้อมูลในการกำหนดนโยบายและการวางแผน
  • กลยุทธ์การจัดซื้อจัดจ้าง
  • ให้คำแนะนำ และระบุสิ่งที่ควรปรับปรุงจากข้อมูลที่วิเคราะห์ได้ เพื่อเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพในการดำเนินการจัดซื้อจัดจ้าง
  • กำกับดูแลการพัฒนารูปแบบรายงาน Procurement Executive Information System เพื่อนำเสนอข้อมูลที่ถูกต้อง และตรงตามวัตถุประสงค์การใช้งานของผู้บริหาร
  • กำกับดูแลการกำหนดโครงสร้างมาตรฐานสินค้าและบริการแต่ละประเภท รวมถึงการบำรุงรักษาฐานข้อมูลสินค้าและผู้ขายให้เป็นไปตามที่กำหนด
  • กำกับดูแลการจัดกลุ่มข้อมูล Material และ Vendor Master ให้มีความถูกต้อง เพื่อใช้ในการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลและการจัดทำรายงานอย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ
  • วางแผนพัฒนาผู้ใต้บังคับบัญชาเพื่อเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพและองค์ความรู้ของทีมงานให้สอดคล้องกับเป้าประสงค์ของธุรกิจ
  • อื่นๆ ตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย


Job Qualification

  • ปริญญาตรี/โท ด้านวิทยาการคอมพิวเตอร์ สถิติ การบริหารจัดการข้อมูลสารสนเทศ หรือสาขาอื่นที่ๆ เกี่ยวข้อง
  • มีประสบการณ์ในด้านงานสารสนเทศและการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลอย่างน้อย 5 - 7 ปี
  • ความรู้ด้านกลยุทธ์การจัดซื้อ
  • ความเข้าใจในกระบวนการทางธุรกิจ
  • ความรู้เกี่ยวกับสินค้าและบริการ
  • ทักษะการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลและรายงาน
  • ทักษะในการใช้งานคอมพิวเตอร์สำหรับคำนวณและนำเสนอข้อมูล (Excel, PPT)
  • ทักษะการนำเสนอ
  • ทักษะการบริหารจัดการบุคลากร

rows.title: Data Analysis Associate
rows.description:
Job Responsibility

  • จัดเก็บและรวบรวมข้อมูลทางธุรกิจเพื่อสร้างรายงานให้กับทีมงานและบริษัท ได้เข้าถึงแหล่งข้อมูลและพร้อมใช้งานได้สะดวกและรวดเร็ว (Data collection)
  • เชื่อมต่อข้อมูลจากฐานข้อมูล (MS SQL Server, MySQL and Postfresql) มายัง Power BI Desktop ดำเนินการจัดทำและวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลจากระบบ Waste Inventory System บัญชีรายการสิ่งแวดล้อม (Inventory analysis) ร่วมกับทีมงานพัฒนาธุรกิจเพื่อประเมินผลกระทบ (Impact assessment) พร้อมประมวลผลที่ได้จากการศึกษาเพื่อจัดทำเป็นรายงานให้แก่ฝ่ายต่างๆในหน่วยงานพัฒนาธุรกิจของบริษัท รวมถึงหน่วยอื่นๆที่เกี่ยวข้อง ด้วย Dashboard หรือ สร้าง Reporting หรือ BI Tool ที่เหมาะสม เพื่อเป็นข้อมูลประกอบการตัดสินใจในการปรับปรุงการบริหารจัดการทรัพยากรและพลังงานที่ใช้ผลิตสินค้าต่างๆให้มีประสิทธิภาพยิ่งขึ้น
  • สามารถจัดเก็บฐานข้อมูลดิบ (Raw Data) ผ่านทาง One Drive และเชื่อมต่อมายัง Power BI Services เพื่อสร้างรายงานในรูปแบบ Power BI Dashboard พร้อมทั้งตั้งเวลาในการ Update ข้อมูลแบบ Auto Refresh ได้
  • เชื่อมต่อระบบ SAP เพื่อทำการสร้างรายงานยอดขายสะสมด้วย Excel Pivot Table หรือ BI Tool ที่เหมาะสม ให้กับบริษัทอาหารเสริมจำกัด และบริษัทจรัญธุรกิจ 52 จำกัด
  • เป็นตัวกลางเพื่อติดต่อประสานงานกับเจ้าหน้าที่ IT ของกลุ่มธุรกิจต่อเนื่องและผู้พัฒนาระบบ เพื่อเสนอแนะหรือหาแนวทางพัฒนาระบบ Waste Inventory System ให้มีประสิทธิภาพอยู่เสมอๆ
  • ให้ความช่วยเหลือกับผู้ใช้งานระบบ Waste Inventory System พร้อมทั้งแยกปัญหาที่เกิดขึ้นเพื่อดำเนินการส่ง Case ให้กับผู้ที่เกี่ยวข้องในการแก้ไขปัญหาได้
  • ประสานงานกับเจ้าหน้า IT ของโรงงานรวมไปถึงผู้ใช้งานระบบ Waste Inventory System เพื่อจัดอบรมระบบ Waste Inventory System ให้แก่ผู้ใช้งานระบบในแต่ละ Business Unit โดยไปถึงผู้ที่เกี่ยวข้อง เพื่อเป็นการให้ความรู้ในการใช้งานระบบและรับฟังข้อเสนอแนะจากผู้ใช้งานระบบ Waste Inventory System


Job Qualification

  • ปริญญาตรีหรือปริญญาโทในสาขาวิทยาการคอมพิวเตอร์, สถิติ , เทคโนโลยีสารสนเทศ หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง

rows.title: SIS Officer
rows.description:
Job Responsibility

• ปฏิบัติงานด้านการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลด้านการตลาดและยอดขาย ในรูปแบบของ รายงานมาตรฐาน (Routine report)

• ปฏิบัติงานด้านการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลด้านการตลาดและยอดขาย ในรูปแบบของ โครงการพิเศษที่ได้รับมอบหมาย (Ad-hoc project)

• ติดต่อประสานงานกับหน่วยงานอื่น ๆ ทั้งภายในและภายนอกเพื่อให้ได้มาซึ่งข้อมูลที่จำเป็นในการวิเคราะห์

• จัดทำข้อมูลยอดขาย ประจำเดือน / สะสม เพื่อเปรียบเทียบต่อเดือน ต่อปี

• รวบรวมและวิเคราะห์เปรียบเทียบข้อมูลคู่แข่งจากรายงานของแต่ละสายงาน เพื่อเป็นข้อมูลในการบริหาร

• รวบรวม สรุป วิเคราะห์ และรายงานเกี่ยวกับ กิจกรรมต่าง ๆ (A&P), ตรวจสอบเงินจูงใจ

• รายงานสินค้าคงเหลือ – อายุเบียร์ เอเย่นต์ / ซับเอเย่นต์ ราย SKU

• ดำเนินการจัดเก็บและปรับปรุงข้อมูลให้มีความทันสมัยอยู่เสมอ


Job Qualification

• ปริญญาตรีบัญชี สถิติ บริหารธุรกิจ เศรษฐศาสตร์ หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง

• มีประสบการณ์ด้านสถิติข้อมูลอย่างน้อย 2 ปี

• มีความสามารถทางด้านคอมพิวเตอร์ MS Office เป็นอย่างดี โดยเฉพาะ Excel และ PowerPoint

• มีทักษะในสื่อสาร ประสานงานอย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ มีมนุษย์สัมพันธ์ดี

• มีความละเอียดรอบคอบ

rows.title: Sales Data Analysis and Report Associate (FSR)
rows.description:
Job Responsibility

• จัดทำรายงานเปรียบเทียบต่างๆ เช่น รายวัน, รายเดือน, รายปี และเปรียบเทียบกับยอดขายย้อนหลัง และเป้าหมาย เพื่อเสนอผู้บริหาร

• จัดทำข้อมูลการจ่ายเงินจูงใจให้กับพนักงานฝ่ายขาย

• จัดทำข้อมูลรายงานผลการปฏิบัติงานที่เกี่ยวข้องกับฝ่ายขายและฝ่าย Customer Management

• ประสานงานกับหน่วยงานสาขา และสำนักสารสนเทศ เพื่อพัฒนาระบบข้อมูล

• ติดตาม ประมวลผล การใช้ข้อมูลจากระบบคลังข้อมูล (Data Warehouse), ระบบ VSMS และพัฒนาฐานข้อมูลอย่างต่อเนื่อง

• การจัดทำ Template เพื่อจัดเก็บฐานข้อมูลเข้าระบบ BMS, PAM, BSS, VSA, HAS ฯลฯ และนำข้อมูลไปใช้ได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

• พัฒนาระบบการจัดเก็บข้อมูล/ ระบบการทำงานโดยใช้ประโยชน์จากระบบสารสนเทศให้เกิดประโยชน์สูงสุด


Job Qualification

• ปริญญาตรี สาขาเศรษฐศาสตร์ สถิติประยุกต์ หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง

Professional Experiences (ประสบการณ์การทำงาน)

• มีประสบการณ์ด้านวิเคราะห์ข้อมูล และสถิติ อย่างน้อย 3 ปี

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS (ความรู้และทักษะ):

• มีทักษะการใช้คอมพิวเตอร์ได้เป็นอย่างดี : Microsoft Office; Word ,Power Point, โดยเฉพาะ Excel ขั้นสูง

• มีความรู้ความสามารถในการวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลเชิงตัวเลขและสถิติ

• มีความสามารถทางการวิเคราะห์เชิงปริมาณ การวางแผนและการจัดการอย่างเป็นระบบและมีมาตรฐานในการทำงาน รวมถึงการติดตามผลงานอย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

• มีทักษะในการเจรจาต่อรองอย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

ทักษะด้านมนุษยสัมพันธ์ที่จำเป็นต่อการปฏิบัติงาน

• กล้าเผชิญและปรับตัวให้เข้ากับการเปลี่ยนแปลง รวมทั้งกล้าที่จะตัดสินใจและอดทนต่อภาวะกดดัน

• มีความละเอียดรอบคอบสูง

• มีทักษะในการวางแผน การจัดการและการวิเคราะห์เชิงเหตุผล

• มีความรู้ ทักษะที่ดีในสายงานข้อมูล สถิติ และวิคราะห์

• มีความสนใจในการเรียนรู้สิ่งใหม่ๆเสมอ

• สามารถสื่อสารและประสานงานได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

• มีทักษะแก้ไขปัญหาและการตัดสินใจอย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

• มีทัศนคติในเชิงบวก และมีทัศนคติที่ดีในงานบริการ

rows.title: Frontend Angular
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

  • Develop Front End features and components using Angular framework.
  • Collaborate with back-end developers and UI/UX designers to implement and integrate front-end elements with server-side logic.
  • Design and implement Microfront End architecture to ensure modular, scalable, and maintainable codebase.
  • Write unit tests and conduct thorough testing to ensure the reliability and performance of applications.
  • Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
  • Utilize Sonarqube to conduct code quality checks and address any identified issues.
  • Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
  • Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve development processes and tools.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to a collaborative and innovative team environment.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in front-end development with strong proficiency in Angular framework.
  • Proven experience in Microfront End architecture and designing modular web applications.
  • Experience with code quality analysis tools like Sonarqube.
  • Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and related web technologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot issues efficiently.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies is a plus.

rows.title: Full Stack Programmer
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

  • Develop, test, and maintain scalable and secure web applications tailored to business banking needs using .NET C# and PHP.
  • Design and implement intuitive front-end features using modern frameworks and technologies to enhance user experience.
  • Create and integrate APIs to facilitate seamless interactions between web applications, mobile apps, and third-party services.
  • Manage and optimize databases, including MySQL, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL, ensuring data integrity and performance.
  • Deploy, monitor, and manage applications on AWS, utilizing services such as EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda to ensure reliability and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other developers, to deliver robust banking solutions.
  • Utilize GitLab for source code control, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance, ensuring high availability and responsiveness.
  • Implement security best practices to protect sensitive financial data and comply with regulatory requirements.


Requirements:

  • At least 2 years of experience
  • Proven experience as a Full-Stack Developer in a financial or business banking environment.
  • Strong proficiency in .NET C# development, with additional experience in PHP.
  • Solid understanding of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js).
  • Experience in developing and integrating secure and efficient RESTful APIs.
  • Proficiency in working with MySQL, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL databases.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services and infrastructure management.
  • Familiarity with GitLab and CI/CD pipeline setup and maintenance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with a focus on security and compliance.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in financial services or business banking technology.
  • Knowledge of mobile app development and integration.
  • Understanding of containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with security best practices in financial applications and cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management tools.

rows.title: Product Specialist & Buyer
rows.description:
Role and Responsibilities:


  • Work closely with VMD (Visual Merchandising Department) and data analysis team to conduct market research and analysis to identify potential suppliers, products, and services that align with the organization's needs.
  • Coordinate with vendor (existing & new vendor) to seek good quality product with affordable price. Ensuring effective communication and negotiation for favorable terms and conditions.
  • Analyze and evaluate supplier proposals, taking into consideration price, quality, delivery times, and other relevant factors.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as production, logistics, and finance, to ensure efficient supply chain management and timely delivery of goods and services.
  • Monitor inventory levels and anticipate demand, making purchase decisions to maintain optimal stock levels while minimizing excess or obsolete inventory.
  • Stay updated with industry trends, market conditions, and technological advancements to identify opportunities for cost savings, process improvements, and supplier performance optimization.
  • Maintain accurate records of purchases, contracts, and supplier information, utilizing procurement software and systems.



Required Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills to effectively interact with suppliers, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Analytical mindset to analyze market trends, pricing data, and supplier proposals to make informed purchasing decisions.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency in procurement software and systems to manage purchasing processes, track inventory, and generate reports.
  • Problem-solving abilities to address and resolve issues with suppliers, inventory management, and supply chain disruptions.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and establish productive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Financial acumen to analyze pricing structures, cost-saving opportunities, and budget management.
  • Knowledge of relevant industry regulations, ethical procurement practices, and sustainability initiatives.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to adjust to changing market conditions, supplier availability, and business requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Buyer or in a similar procurement role, preferably in the industry relevant to the organization at least 3 years.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft365 e.g. Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Words and Power Point.
  • Ability to work well under pressure and navigate multiple deadlines.
  • Ability to work well independently and in collaboration with others.
  • Strong team player with a proactive approach and the ability to take initiative.
  • Proficiency in using English and Thai to communicate internal and external.
  • Thorough understanding of agency business to manage client satisfaction in highest level.
  • Strong passion in market trend, customer insight is a plus.

• นำเสนอผลิตภัณฑ์ใหม่ให้การตลาด ฝ่ายขาย และลูกค้า

• จัดทำข้อมูลผลิตภัณฑ์ใหม่ในระบบ

• ควบคุมดูแลการพัฒนาสินค้าและสร้างมาตรฐานการผลิตสินค้าภายในโรงงาน

 

คุณสมบัติที่ต้องการ

• วุฒิการศึกษาปริญญาตรีขึ้นไป สาขาวิทยาศาสตร์การอาหาร (Food Science) พัฒนาผลิตภัณฑ์ (Product Development) เทคโนโลยีอาหาร (Food Technology) หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง

• มีความรู้และความสามารถในด้านการพัฒนาผลิตภัณฑ์อาหาร

• มีความคิดสร้างสรรค์ กระตือรือร้นที่จะเรียนรู้สิ่งใหม่ ๆ อยู่ตลอดเวลา และสามารถนำมาใช้ในการพัฒนาสินค้าที่รับผิดชอบได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

• มีทักษะการวิเคราะห์แก้ไขปัญหาและการตัดสินใจ

• มีความสามาถทางด้านภาษาสามารถพูด อ่าน และเขียน ภาษาอังกฤษ ได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

• มีประสบการณ์ที่เกี่ยวข้อง 2 ปีขึ้นไป (ประสบการณ์ RD โรงงานอาหาร)
